quote: conjectured by Ernst Leonard Lindelöf in 1908 in 'Quelques remarques sur la croissance de la fonction ζ(s)', Bull. Sci. Math., 32: 341–356
note: The density hypothesis for zeroes is not a separate conjecture with its own origin; it is a consequence of the Lindelöf hypothesis (1908), which concerns the growth of ζ(1/2 + it) along the critical line. The density hypothesis states A(σ) ≤ 2 for 1/2 ≤ σ ≤ 1 and would follow from the Lindelöf hypothesis. Dating this to the parent conjecture: 1908.
